description: LAUNCHING SOON: answers 503 until event discovery goes live. One event read fresh from its platform, in the same shape as `events_search`, with Luma's categories and Partiful's hosts by name. Costs $0.0015; an unknown id is a free 404, and a platform that cannot be read with no stored copy is a free 503. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

id.description: The event id from an `events_search` result, such as `luma.evt-AbC123` or `partiful.AbC123xyz`.

name: event_get
title: Get Event
